payload.prompt: Cree una dimensión contable personalizada "Kostsenter" con los valores "Markedsføring" y "Kundeservice". Luego registre un asiento en la cuenta 7000 por 30250 NOK, vinculado al valor de dimensión "Kundeservice".

payload.goal: Create a custom accounting dimension "Kostsenter" with values "Markedsføring" and "Kundeservice", then post a voucher on account 7000 for 30250 NOK linked to dimension value "Kundeservice".
success_checks: Voucher is created with a line on account 7000 for 30250 NOK.
Voucher line is linked to dimension value "Kundeservice".
risk_notes: No voucher date provided; API may require accounting date.
No balancing counter-account provided; voucher creation may fail unless a balancing line/account is added.
Custom dimension creation may require a feature/module to be enabled first.
Currency is NOK, but amount posting rules and debit/credit direction are not specified.
payload.suggested_first_action: enable or verify support for custom accounting dimensions, then create dimension "Kostsenter"

line_items.description: Voucher posting on account 7000 linked to dimension value Kundeservice

ordered_steps: Check whether custom accounting dimensions are enabled; enable module/settings if required.
Create custom dimension named "Kostsenter" via settings/dimensions endpoint.
Fetch account 7000 from chart of accounts and verify it is active/postable.
Create balanced voucher draft with one line on account 7000 amount 30250 NOK tagged with dimension value "Kundeservice" and one balancing line on a suitable counter-account.
Verify voucher lines include the dimension linkage to "Kundeservice".

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.
Create a new free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimension
Create a new value for one of the free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimensions

rules: ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex auto-generates VAT and credit postings.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.text:
Let me analyze the task:

1. Create a custom accounting dimension "Kostsenter" with values "Markedsføring" and "Kundeservice"
2. Post a voucher on account 7000 for 30250 NOK linked to dimension value "Kundeservice"

Following the trace template:
1. GET /ledger/account?number=7000 - Resolve expense account
2. GET /ledger/account?number=1920 - Resolve counter-account (bank)
3. POST /ledger/accountingDimensionName - Create "Kostsenter"
4. POST /ledger/accountingDimensionValue - Create "Markedsføring"


5. POST /ledger/accountingDimensionValue - Create "Kundeservice"
6. POST /ledger/voucher - Create voucher with balanced postings

I need to handle the dependencies carefully: steps 1, 2, and 3 can run in parallel since they're independent, but I'll need the dimension index from step 3 before creating the dimension values, and the account IDs from steps 1 and 2 before posting the voucher. Let me check the schemas to ensure I construct the dimension and voucher requests correctly.

I'll analyze the task and execute it following the trace template. I need to:
1. Resolve accounts 7000 and 1920
2. Create custom dimension "Kostsenter" with two values
3. Create a balanced voucher
